data.title: 神裂火织 · 卧房榻榻米上的圣人动情献身
data.description: 昏黄静谧的和风卧室内，深蓝真丝睡袍从高挑雪白的香肩滑落。平时威严无双的圣人跪伏在被单间，乌黑长马尾散落，双颊绯红、眼泛泪光地抱住你的颈项，在急促娇喘中奉献出全部身心。
data.location: dim peaceful Japanese bedroom with soft white futon
data.action: kneeling on futon with nightgown slipping off bare shoulders, embracing partner passionately, weeping sweet tears of total surrender and love
data.lighting: dim warm ambient lantern light glowing on statuesque curves and flushed skin
data.mood: commanding warrior absolute surrender, breathtaking passion, sacred lovers consummation
data.promptProse: On a bedroom futon with slipping indigo nightgown, Kaori Kanzaki embraces partner with tearful passionate devotion and flushed breathless kisses.
data.animaCaption: Kaori Kanzaki with bare shoulders embracing partner passionately on futon.
